facts.note: At the nine o'clock temple bell, Aurèle had everyone show him their watches; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Same timepiece, reading and relation as the fact sheet.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat; Madame began playing the piano as he left and stopped when he returned. All elements match.
During the game, when the temple struck ten, Vauthier noticed the salon clock showed five minutes to ten and remarked on it to Madame. Matches the sheet.
